videoStudio.renderFast: Fast - AI images with motion (done in minutes)
videoStudio.renderHelpCinematic: Each scene renders as a 10-second AI video clip. Gateway clip quota is limited - scenes that hit the cap fall back to animated AI images and the video still completes.
videoStudio.renderHelpFast: Every scene is an AI image with camera motion + narration. Estimate: a 90-second Short finishes in ±2-3 minutes.
videoStudio.runningNote: Render is running. You can close this page and come back via history.
